title: Computational insights into the differentiated binding affinities of Myc, Max, and Omomyc dimers to the E-boxes of DNA.
authors: Dai, Yuxin; Zhang, Jinyuan; Wang, Yinchuan; Liu, Linlin; Gao, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和MM/GBSA计算系统比较了Myc/Max/Omomyc五种二聚体与DNA E-box的结合亲和力及关键残基贡献，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Myc is a bHLHZip protein involved in growth control and cancer, which does not form a homodimer. Myc operates in a network with its heterodimerization partner Max, the latter of which can form homodimer and heterodimer. Omomyc, a polypeptide, can block Myc to treat cancers because it can both homodimerize as efficiently as Max and heterodimerize with both Myc and Max. However, the binding efficiencies to DNA for the mentioned two homodimers (Omomyc-Omomyc and Max-Max) and three heterodimers (Myc-Max, Omomyc-Myc, and Omomyc-Max) are still controversial. By molecular dynamics simulations and MM/GBSA free energy calculation, we ranked the binding affinities of five dimers to DNA and analyzed the contribution of single amino acids to the molecular recognition of dimers to DNA. Our simulation showed that the Omomyc-Omomyc dimer exhibited the highest binding energy to DNA, followed by the Omomyc-Myc, Max-Max, Omomyc-Max, and Myc-Max dimers. Moreover, five Arg residues (i.e., 7, 8, 15, 17, and 18 numbered by Omomyc) and five Lys residues (i.e., 6, 22, 40, 43, and 48 numbered by Omomyc) dominated the binding of various dimers to DNA while the residues Asp23 and Asp37 weakened the affinities via repulsive interaction. Our simulation would provide worthy information for further development of the structure-based design of novel Omomyc-like peptide inhibitors against Myc in the future.
abstract_zh: Myc是一种参与生长调控和癌症的bHLHZip蛋白，其不能形成同源二聚体。Myc与其异源二聚化伙伴Max在一个网络中运作，后者能形成同源二聚体和异源二聚体。Omomyc是一种多肽，可通过阻断Myc来治疗癌症，因为它既能像Max一样高效地同源二聚化，又能与Myc和Max异源二聚化。然而，上述两种同源二聚体（Omomyc-Omomyc和Max-Max）及三种异源二聚体（Myc-Max、Omomyc-Myc和Omomyc-Max）与DNA的结合效率仍存在争议。通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和MM/GBSA自由能计算，我们对五种二聚体与DNA的结合亲和力进行了排序，并分析了单个氨基酸对二聚体与DNA分子识别的贡献。我们的模拟显示，Omomyc-Omomyc二聚体与DNA的结合能最高，其次是Omomyc-Myc、Max-Max、Omomyc-Max和Myc-Max二聚体。此外，五个Arg残基（即按Omomyc编号的7、8、15、17和18位）和五个Lys残基（即按Omomyc编号的6、22、40、43和48位）主导了各种二聚体与DNA的结合，而残基Asp23和Asp37通过排斥作用削弱了亲和力。我们的模拟将为未来基于结构设计新型Omomyc样肽抑制剂以对抗Myc提供有价值的信息。
